## Design

### 2026-10-07 – I first worked on the schematics of my project. The process first required researching the pinout of each part and layout. Then I laid the schematics  and started working on the footprint of the esp32

**1.45h**

I first worked on the schematics of my project. The process first required researching the pinout of each part and layout. Then I laid the schematics  and started working on the footprint of the esp32 microcontroller I'm using. I used dimensions of the microcontroller available online. I still havent finished the footprints of all the components but i will do that later to finally make the pcb where all the components schould go.

### 2026-10-10 – IM DONEEE!!!

**3.5h**

IM DONEEE!!!

So today was a very intense day, i started working on the footprints previously, however, the number pads were all wrong, moreover, most of the measurements were off by a pretty millimeter. Sadly I realized that after I had already finished ALL of the footprints. Safe to say i was on the edge of throwing away my laptop.

Luckily, as today is Saturday i managed to redo all of the footprints and reroute what I had already routed on the previous PCB. As you can probably tell by the pictures, the routing is somewhat... holistic? Nonetheless, the routing is done (whether it fully works is something Ill find out when I build the project). I used a ton of vias and managed to make all of the components fit on a round pcb with a 6 cm radius. While it is a bit bigger than i had hoped originally, id rather have it be a tad bigger than rerouting the whole thing.

Lastly, as you also may notice there is no GND area, that is because my routing skills are simply so eccentric that the mere idea of a grounding plane  is against my routing technique. HAHA, jokes aside the routing was so poorly done (Mainly bc i was frustrated bc of the previous incident) that a GND plane/area (sorry english not my first language) would have had to have a MINIMAL clearence and islands would appear

### 2026-10-11 – FINALLY! I had to reinstall KiCAD because some problems with the installation made it impossible for me to load the 3D models of my components. After reinstalling, however, the project couldnt be loca

**3.5h**

FINALLY! I had to reinstall KiCAD because some problems with the installation made it impossible for me to load the 3D models of my components. After reinstalling, however, the project couldnt be located by KiCAD bc it was in another disk (?) and windows error msgs kept popping up. Though after restarting the PC it worked. Moreover i had to do some tweaks to the pcb design to allocate the 3d models. and that meant rerouting some parts. But im happy to say that the schematics and pcb of THEE smartest paperweight EVER are done!
